repos_data.description: MCP Server for IBGE APIs - Brazilian geographic, demographic and statistical data

MCP server providing access to Brazilian public data (CNPJ, CEP, banks, holidays, DDD, ISBN, economic rates, exchange rates, CVM brokers, IBGE states/municipalities, .br domains) via BrasilAPI. For Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients.

Servidor MCP oficial da SignDocs Brasil: assinatura eletrônica e digital com ICP-Brasil, biometria e OTP direto de agentes de IA. Official MCP server for the SignDocs Brasil e-signature API — signing sessions, envelopes, document verification.
